status: Partial implementation; source-conflicted expansions and standalone prefinal licenses remain open.
scope: Per-entry intention adjective uncertainty with final rhetorical preservation and local component ownership. Raw engine behavior and both candidate filters are unchanged.

native_integrity.method: Compare all native entry fields, notes/forms/senses/examples and English equivalents to hashed pinned LMF exports; omit RelatedForm and non-English equivalents.

validation.rust: Passed full offline web-feature suite including stress tests; all 4 final focused tests pass.
validation.clippy: Passed all targets with warnings denied.
validation.browser: Passed full browser/HTTP suite; inspected desktop/mobile screenshots. Initial fixture comparison used JSON key order and was corrected to compare explicit fields.
validation.nix: Passed default and web package builds with release Rust tests, web-assets and inventory-review flake checks on x86_64-linux. Other declared platforms were not executed.
validation.packaged_runtime: Passed 45 cases / 66 entry judgments with full native dictionary, both CLI filters and exact HTTP/CLI parity; prior preview regressions preserved.
validation.release_performance: Three interleaved release runs per version/filter: approximately 1.5 seconds and 30 MiB peak RSS for the complete novel. Descriptive measurements, not statistical equivalence.
validation.live_preview: Refreshed and verified http://localhost:8081 against packaged CLI and the complete native dictionary; temporary 8082 server stopped.

limitations: Per-entry statuses describe scoped dictionary evidence, not contextual grammaticality or a selected sense. Unknown candidates are retained.
The complete novel has zero changed records under either filter, so it does not measure this policy’s contextual accuracy on adjective intention constructions.
Annotated corpus scans document exact ending hits; no new independently annotated adjective/coercive gold or improved recall is claimed.
Broad adjective rejection/acceptance, standalone modal/retrospective licensing and conflicted full expansions remain unimplemented pending stronger evidence.
Independent Korean review remains pending; authored cases do not estimate precision.

competing_copular_gold.interpretation: Unmodified KAIST training annotation explicitly treats 인간적이려고 as nominal + relational suffix + copula + connective ending, followed by separately written 하는. This is competing corpus evidence for the broader copula/state-making audit; preservation does not make the annotated usage a universal normative license.
